![kody code-review](https://img.shields.io/badge/kody-code--review-312B4B?labelColor=C9BBF2) ![Bug](https://img.shields.io/badge/Bug-B71C1C) ![medium](https://img.shields.io/badge/severity_level-medium-1A7BBE)


**Dynamic dashboard URL not used when endReviewMessage is rendered**

When `endReviewMessage` is configured, the finish-comment path in `finish-comments.stage.ts` renders `endReviewMessage.content` directly and never calls `generateConfigReviewMarkdown`, so self-hosted installs still get the cloud link from `default-kodus-config.yml`. Replace the hard-coded URL in that default `endReviewMessage.content` with a `{{dashboardUrl}}` placeholder resolved from `API_USER_INVITE_BASE_URL`, or substitute it when rendering the template.



<details>
<summary>Prompt for LLM</summary>

````text
File libs/code-review/infrastructure/adapters/services/commentManager.service.ts, lines 2341-2343:

Dynamic dashboard URL not used when endReviewMessage is rendered

The dynamic dashboard URL is only applied on the default finish-comment path: when an `endReviewMessage` is configured, `finish-comments.stage.ts` renders `endReviewMessage.content` through `processEndReviewMessageTemplate` and `createComment`/`updateOverallComment` append only the notice suffixes (lines 1268-1291, 3207-3246) — `generateConfigReviewMarkdown` never runs, so this fix cannot change that rendered link. The shipped default for that template is `default-kodus-config.yml:1225-1271`, whose `endReviewMessage.content` still hard-codes `https://app.kodus.io/settings/code-review/global/general`, and `FindByRepositoryOrDirectoryIdPullRequestMessagesUseCase` merges those file defaults into what the settings UI loads and persists. Result: self-hosted installs that have a customized end-review message (the shipped default status is `every_push`) still send users to the cloud dashboard, so the fix is dead on the path that actually ships the link. Replace the hard-coded URL in the default `endReviewMessage.content` with a `{{dashboardUrl}}`-style placeholder resolved from `API_USER_INVITE_BASE_URL` (same as `resolvePartialErrorsNotice`), or substitute the link when rendering the template.
````

</details>
